entries.text: A chain's upstream can be picked from a subscription, creating a group that carries it so a node of that sub is reachable as the upstream
A chain's upstream can be typed in as type, address, port and account, creating the proxy for you; a typed upstream is declared in the config even when no group names it
The dialer page is now a proxy chain view: every proxy a group names is shown as an exit with its upstream address, a group upstream shows the group, and a proxy with no upstream reads as direct
A chain naming a proxy the config does not declare is dropped, and a chain through such a name is no longer offered; one dangling reference used to make the core reject the whole profile
Builds up to 1.0.11 look for releases at GuLiang-I/GLClash, which is suspended. They cannot see this version and have to be updated by hand once.
Every release is published on Codeberg beside GitHub; when the GitHub API and the release page both fail, the update check asks Codeberg instead of giving up.

A download walks every host that serves the same file, and the transferred installer is checked against its SHA-256 before it runs, so a damaged or truncated transfer is retried from the next host instead of being installed.
